primaryTextRead.text: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

wikipediaRead.title: Eliezer
wikipediaRead.locator: L140–141: the prophet subsection names his father Dodavah and quotes 2 Chronicles 20:37; this supports the relationship, not a separate dedicated biography of Dodavah.
